description: Event catalogue for the Commercial VRP Consent Setup journey. Introduces 3 events: EVT-156 through EVT-158. All events published by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003).

events.name: VrpConsentGranted
events.trigger: Customer completes SCA and explicitly grants VRP consent. VrpConsent status set to active.

consumers.action: Update Open Banking API response; return consent_id and authorisation code to PISP.
Send consent confirmation notification to customer.
Write immutable consent grant record (6-year retention).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic payments.vrp.
events.worm_rationale: VRP consent grant with SCA assertion is a regulated payment authorisation — immutable for FCA/PSR audit trail.

events.name: VrpPaymentExecuted
events.trigger: VRP payment instruction validated against consent parameters and fraud score; Faster Payment executed successfully.

consumers.action: Debit source account; update transaction history.
Send payment confirmation to customer (per notification preferences).
Post-execution fraud model update for VRP behaviour patterns.
Write immutable payment execution audit record.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic payments.vrp.
events.worm_rationale: VRP payment execution is a regulated payment transaction — immutable for PSR dispute resolution and FCA audit.

events.name: VrpConsentRevoked
events.trigger: Customer revokes VRP consent via consent dashboard (SCA required) OR PISP deletes consent via API OR consent expiry date reached.

consumers.action: Update consent management dashboard; trigger PISP webhook callback.
Send revocation confirmation to customer and PISP.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key. VrpConsentRevoked must follow VrpConsentGranted for same consent_id.
events.worm_rationale: Consent revocation is a regulated action affecting payment authorisation — immutable record required for dispute resolution.
